params:
  data_path:         null          # path to a prepared .rda or .csv; null = use shipped data
  candidate:         "mecca"       # candidate destination id
  tolerance_deg:     5             # angular tolerance for hypothesis test
  k_clusters:        3             # number of directional clusters

  seed:              42
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(qiblalab)
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(params$seed)
```

## Data

```{r load-data}
if (is.null(params$data_path)) {
  data(gibson_qibla)
  mosques <- gibson_qibla
} else {
  mosques <- readRDS(params$data_path)
}

data(destinations)

cat(nrow(mosques), "mosques,", sum(!is.na(mosques$azimuth)),
    "with measured azimuths.\n")
```

## Directional distribution

```{r rose}
plot_rose(mosques)
```

```{r circ-summary}
circular_summary(mosques$azimuth, na.rm = TRUE)
```

## Hypothesis test

```{r hypothesis}
h <- qibla_hypothesis(
  name      = paste("Orientation toward", params$candidate),
  candidate = params$candidate,
  tolerance = params$tolerance_deg
)

result <- test_qibla_hypothesis(h, mosques)
print(result)
```

### Residuals

```{r residuals}
plot_residuals(result)
```

### Sensitivity

```{r sensitivity}
plot_sensitivity(result)
```

## Candidate comparison

```{r compare}
cmp <- compare_qibla_hypotheses(mosques)
plot_candidate_comparison(cmp)
```

## Destination-blind clustering

```{r cluster}
res <- cluster_qiblas(mosques, k = params$k_clusters, seed = params$seed)
print(res)
```

```{r cluster-profiles}
plot_cluster_profile(res)
```

```{r cluster-map}
map_clusters(res)
```

### Validation

```{r validate}
val <- validate_clusters(
  res,
  external    = c("gibson_classification", "age_group"),
  bootstrap_n = params$bootstrap_n,
  seed        = params$seed
)
print(val)
```
